svg.text: Customer reported intermittent 502s and a failed security audit. The review below highlights three
configuration issues found in the production environment and one informational note about the

g.title: contoso-ai (Application Insights) Telemetry sink for the web tier.
contoso-agw (Application Gateways) Public entry point for all customer traffic. SKU: WAF v2 Mode: Detection Backend: contoso-web
contoso-web (App Services) Customer-facing API, .NET 8. SKU: P2v3 TLS: 1.0 Public access: Enabled
contoso-sql (SQL Database) Tier: Hyperscale Firewall: 0.0.0.0 allowed

svg.text: Application Gateway forwards customer traffic to the App Service backend pool.
API reads and writes order data using SQL authentication.
Secrets and connection strings fetched at startup.
The App Service minimum TLS version is 1.0, which fails the customer's compliance baseline and modern client
Fix: Set minimum TLS version to 1.2 under Configuration > General settings.
The 'Allow Azure services' rule plus a 0.0.0.0 start-IP rule effectively expose the server to any Azure tenant.
Fix: Remove the open rule and use a private endpoint in snet-data.

text.tspan: — Gateway to backend is plain HTTP

svg.text: Traffic between Application Gateway and App Service is unencrypted inside the vnet.
Fix: Switch the backend setting to HTTPS and pin the App Service certificate.

text.tspan: — No NSG on the app subnet

svg.text: snet-app has no network security group, so lateral traffic in the vnet is unrestricted.
Fix: Attach an NSG allowing only AppGw subnet ingress on 443.
Full telemetry sampling is driving ingestion cost; consider adaptive sampling.
